# Glint

Glint is a static Markdown wiki SPA. It renders GitHub Flavored Markdown, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, wiki links, citations, task widgets, and comment blocks.

## Wiki links

Use `[[Page Name]]` or `[[Page Name|Display Text]]`. A missing internal page can be created from the rendered link.

## Math

Use `$inline$` for inline LaTeX and `$$\nblock\n$$` for block math. Rendering uses KaTeX.

## Citations

Add references under `## References` as `- [ref:id] "Title" Author (Year) URL`, then cite with `[[#ref:id]]`.

## Tasks

Use `- [state] description (metadata)`. States are `[ ]`, `[x]`, `[/]`, `[w]`, `[b]`, and `[c]`.

## Comments

Use a `comment` fenced block with `author@YYYY-MM-DD:HH:MM message` entries. Optional flags are `#resolved` and `#important`.
